newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes raid south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes raided on Wednesday suspected Hizbollah targets in south Lebanon, Lebanese security sources said.
Two planes fired four rockets into the Iqlim al-Toufah ridges north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, they said.
Five minutes later, the warplanes fired four more rockets into the same area.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack.
It was Israel's second air raid on Lebanon in two days. On Tuesday, jets rocketed Hizbollah bases in the Syrian-policed eastern Bekaa Valley.
